title: La barbería
goal: Get the haircut you actually asked for
culture: No numbers, no guards and no photographs. He asks as he goes and you answer in two-word instructions, which is why this is a listening mission disguised as a haircut.

beats.good: Más corto is the whole instruction, and he will ask about the rest as he goes. There is no number and no attachment on the clippers.
The two words that stop a haircut from turning into a different haircut. Say them before he starts, not after.
Así está bien again — the same phrase that stops the butcher’s scale. It stops anything, anywhere, without giving offence.

beats.en: Leave it as it is. Thank you.
beats.good: Déjelo así — leave it. Useful in a barbershop and in every other situation where somebody is about to improve something of yours.
